description: This file implements the advanced interface functions for the TLS Connection Controller Object, handling events, connection parameters, session configurations, alert generation, and cipher specification changes within the TLS protocol implementation.

classes.name: PTLS_CONN_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the TLS Connection Controller Object managing various TLS connection operations.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcNotifyEvent(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulEvent,ULONG ulError,ANSC_HANDLE hEventContext)
methods.description: Handles events from the TLS protocol, such as handshake success, alerts, and cipher spec changes, notifying relevant subsystems and managing session states.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsCcoCbcGetConnParams(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the current connection parameters for the TLS session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcSetSessionID(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR session_id,ULONG session_id_size)
methods.description: Configures the session ID for the TLS connection, used for session resumption.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcSetSessionSharing(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bSessionSharing)
methods.description: Sets whether session sharing (reusing sessions) is enabled.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcSetQuickHandshake(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bQuickHandshake)
methods.description: Configures whether to perform a quick handshake, possibly skipping some steps for faster connection setup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcSetCipherSuiteArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * item_array,ULONG item_count)
methods.description: Sets the list of cipher suites supported by the connection.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcSetCompressionArray(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * item_array,ULONG item_count)
methods.description: Sets the supported compression methods for the TLS connection.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcGenerateAlert(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,UCHAR alert_level,UCHAR alert_descr)
methods.description: Generates a TLS alert message, such as fatal errors or warnings.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCbcChangeCipherSpec(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sends out a change cipher spec message to switch to new encryption keys.
